title: A theme gallery at /themes shows every theme with its starter kits and a door to start

source.ref: Mega Theme plan, the theme gallery (ADR-1895)

detail: One card per theme read from SITE_THEMES and the kit index, each kit linking to Space creation with its niche, Midnight with its live preview and feature page. A theme with no kit yet says so and opens the setup door.

verify.evidence: Probe passes; the page renders in vitest.
